title: CorpusRelease release manifest (release-manifest.json)
description: PRD §18.4: 'The manifest MUST include parent release, schema/parser/chunker/embedding/index versions, artifact hashes, counts, coverage, quarantine summary, evaluation results, file hashes/sizes, build time and app/search compatibility.' Every member below maps to one of those phrases or to a PRD §35.3 corpus_release column, plus the model/tokenizer/runtime pinning members required by breakdown plan §8 Q11 (confirmed). schemas/corpus-manifest/** is PRD §44.3 serial-owned by module 04-corpus-contract; no other module may write it.

manifest_version.description: Contract versioning (PRD §45.4). The schema directory is v<major>: adding an optional member is a minor bump in place; removing or renaming a member, or tightening a type, is a major bump into a new schemas/corpus-manifest/v<N>/ directory. The verifier accepts the current and the immediately previous major.

release_kind.description: Manifest-only vocabulary. CANDIDATE — built by CRPS-06, not yet published; PUBLISHED — staged by CRPS-07; SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE — generated test data (CRPS-08). PRD §12.2 requires failed/candidate material to be unable to touch active data, and breakdown plan A4 requires a signed synthetic release for RETR-01; without an explicit marker a fixture bundle is byte-indistinguishable from a promotable release. This is NOT a corpus_release.status enum value — the SQLite enum stays FND-03's.

parent_release_id.description: PRD §18.4 'parent release' — corpus_release.parent_id (§35.3). Null for the first release in a lineage.

created_at.description: PRD §18.4 'build time' — when the manifest itself was created (corpus_release.created_at, §35.3).

build_started_at.description: PRD §18.4 'build time' — when the offline build began.

build_finished_at.description: PRD §18.4 'build time' — when the offline build finished.

versions.description: PRD §18.4 'schema/parser/chunker/embedding/index versions', plus the builder and contract versions corpus_meta records so readiness (PRD §42.1) can compare them.

schema.description: The corpus schema version. MUST equal corpus_meta.schema_version inside corpus.sqlite (PRD §42.1: 'Readiness fails during incompatible app/corpus/schema state').

contract.description: The intermediate normalised-record contract version — corpus_meta.contract_version.

compatibility.description: PRD §18.4 'app/search compatibility'. PRD §21: 'Trust application/corpus artifacts only after signature/hash/compatibility verification.'

app.description: The application versions this release may be loaded by.

search.description: The search-engine versions this release may be loaded by.

corpus_schema.description: The corpus schema version a consumer must implement.

files.description: PRD §18.4 'file hashes/sizes'. One entry per file in the bundle, bundle-root-relative with '/' separators, sorted by path. release-manifest.json is EXCLUDED — a manifest cannot carry its own hash; its integrity is manifest_sha256 plus the signature. Symlinks and other non-regular files are refused at build time and are a finding at verify time.

artifacts.description: PRD §18.4 'artifact hashes' — the four bundle artefacts of the §18.4 layout, each cross-checked against its files[] entry by verify_bundle().

corpus_sqlite_sha256.description: SHA-256 of corpus.sqlite, equal to its files[] entry.

lexical_index_sha256.description: DIRECTORY digest of tantivy/, which is a directory rather than a file: SHA-256 over '<relative path>\u001f<file sha256>\n' for every file beneath it, in sorted path order, UTF-8 encoded; an empty directory digests the empty string. RETR-01 and RLSE-07 re-implement this — see docs/adr/0002-corpus-release-signing.md.

vector_index_sha256.description: SHA-256 of vectors.usearch, equal to its files[] entry.

embedding_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of embedding-manifest.json, equal to its files[] entry.

counts.description: PRD §18.4 'counts' — the row cardinalities of the PRD §35 corpus tables the release was built from.

coverage.description: PRD §18.4 'coverage' — one row per source group, so a consumer can state what the release does and does not cover.

quarantine.description: PRD §18.4 'quarantine summary' — what the build refused to publish, and why.

open_count.description: Quarantined items still open at build time.

resolved_count.description: Quarantined items resolved before this build.

by_reason_code.description: Open map from quarantine reason code to count. Open because the reason vocabulary is FND-03's, not this contract's.

evaluation.description: PRD §18.4 'evaluation results'. The member stays REQUIRED even when evaluation has not run: the explicit not-run shape is status NOT_RUN with a null report and empty metrics/gates, and the gating rule lives in CRPS-06. An absent member and an unevaluated release must not look the same.

status.description: NOT_RUN — no evaluation was run for this release; PASSED / FAILED — every gate below was, or was not, satisfied.

report_id.description: Identity of the evaluation report (21-evaluation-600) this summary came from; null when status is NOT_RUN.

ran_at.description: When the evaluation ran; null when status is NOT_RUN.

metrics.description: Open map from metric name to value. Values are DECIMAL STRINGS, never JSON floats — see pins.schema.json#/$defs/decimal for why the signed canonical form admits no float.

gates.description: The evaluation gates and whether each was satisfied.

embedding_profile.description: corpus_release.embedding_profile (PRD §35.3), expanded to the chunk_embedding columns profile_id, dimensions and quantisation. Must agree with embedding-manifest.json.

model_id.description: The model that produced the indexed vectors (value is breakdown plan §8 Q2).

local_models.description: Breakdown plan §8 Q11: 'Models, tokenizers and runtime metadata are pinned in the corpus/retrieval manifest'; 'Model artefacts must carry an immutable revision identifier, hash, dimensions, normalisation, truncation and licence information'. One entry per role the release pins. A release with no entry is a defect, reported by verify_bundle() rather than by this schema (the validator subset carries no minItems).

runtime.description: Breakdown plan §8 Q11: runtime family and version, CPU-only execution providers, the exact pinned `ort` crate version and the exact pinned `tokenizers` crate version. RETR-07 is the confirmed owner of the runtime and may only consume and verify these values.

signature.description: PRD §18.4 'Production verifies signature'. Detached signature over canonical_bytes(manifest), which EXCLUDES `signature` and `manifest_sha256` — otherwise verification would be circular. Consequence: signed_at is outside the signed bytes and is therefore unauthenticated metadata. Null only for an unsigned CANDIDATE.

algorithm.description: The signature scheme. ED25519 (RFC 8032) is the recorded default — docs/adr/0002-corpus-release-signing.md.

key_id.description: Identity of the signing key. A development key's id starts with 'dev-' so a development signature is identifiable in any manifest (PRD §20.2).

value.description: Base64 of the 64-byte detached signature over the canonical bytes.

signed_at.description: When the manifest was signed. UNAUTHENTICATED: it is outside the signed bytes by construction.

manifest_sha256.description: corpus_release.manifest_sha256 (PRD §35.3) — the lowercase hex SHA-256 of canonical_bytes(manifest), which excludes `signature` and `manifest_sha256` themselves.

compatibility_range.description: An inclusive version range. `max: null` means unbounded above.

min.description: The lowest consumer version this release supports.

max.description: The highest consumer version this release supports; null means unbounded.

file_entry.description: PRD §18.4 'file hashes/sizes'. `path` is bundle-root-relative with '/' separators and never escapes the bundle.

path.description: Bundle-root-relative POSIX path. No leading separator, no drive letter, no '..' segment — verify_bundle() rejects any path that escapes the bundle BEFORE reading it.

byte_size.description: The file's size in bytes, checked from stat() before the file is read.

coverage_entry.description: PRD §18.4 'coverage' — one source group's coverage and freshness at build time.

source_group_id.description: The source group this row describes.

coverage_status.description: The group's coverage state. The vocabulary is FND-03's, so this contract records the value rather than re-defining the enum.

freshness_status.description: The group's freshness state. Vocabulary as above.

document_count.description: Documents from this group included in the release.

earliest_effective_from.description: Earliest effective-from date covered; null when the group contributed nothing.

latest_effective_from.description: Latest effective-from date covered; null when the group contributed nothing.

last_ingestion_at.description: When this group was last ingested; null when it never was.

evaluation_gate.description: One evaluation gate. threshold and observed are DECIMAL STRINGS, never JSON floats — the manifest is signed and a Rust verifier must re-derive identical bytes.

threshold.description: The value the gate required, as a decimal string.

observed.description: The value the evaluation measured, as a decimal string.

passed.description: Whether the observed value satisfied the threshold.
